item.subject: maths
item.stem:
Javed compares two class teams. Team A has 4 players and scored 40 goals in all. Team B has 10 players and scored 70 goals in all. He wants a fair comparison of typical scoring when the teams have different sizes.

Which basis is appropriate?

options.A: Use the totals 40 and 70 only, and say Team B is ahead because 70 is larger.
options.B: Compare goals per player (10 versus 7), because the teams have different sizes.
options.C: Compare only whichever team has the single larger total printed in the stem.
options.D: Say Team A is ahead because 4 is smaller than 10, using team size alone as the score.
